verdict.rationale: Box documents read-only shared links on folders with configurable access levels, role-based collaborations for granting outside users access, and event feeds plus download-triggered webhooks that give visibility into who accessed what. A community user also confirms selectively granting outside parties folder access. However, no evidence shows a control to disable or restrict downloads on shared links, and nothing frames these pieces as a data-room workflow. Missing for 10: documented download-disable/restriction controls on shared links, data-room-specific access reporting or audit UI, hands-on corroboration of a diligence use case.
